A route switched off is drawn at 55% opacity: an inactive component, whose text WCAG 1.4.3 exempts. The live state (.rn .lg) is measured and reads.
The play control is inactive while the demo plays itself (opacity .55, pointer-events none): an inactive component, exempt under WCAG 1.4.3. Its live state is measured and reads.

A dark container for code lines: it sets a background and never its own text. Each line is a child with its own colour rule (.k, .s, .n, .b), measured on its own selector; the text the neutral page invents here inherits the page ink.
A dark endpoint bar: it sets the background; its text is the child span, which has its own rule (.ep span) and is measured. The text the neutral page invents in the bar itself inherits the page ink.

A timeline row: the real markup is an icon (i) then a div, laid beside the rail drawn by .w-tl::before; the neutral page puts the invented text over the rail line. In the real row the text never sits on the rail.

At narrow widths the highlighted comparison row becomes a block with the black background; its text is set by its cells (th, td, td[data-l]::before), each measured by its own selector on the page.
Used inside the dark API result panel (.pg__res), which gives the dim role its on-black value (--dim is dimOnDark there); measured in that container, where it reads.
